title: SecondBrain config v1
description: Root config.json and backup configs/<sha256>.json snapshot content. Status: DESIGN_REVIEW contract; no implementation is asserted.
$comment: Structural checks only. A conforming parser and semantic validator must additionally: (1) reject duplicate JSON keys, a BOM, NaN/Infinity and non-UTF-8 input before schema validation; (2) treat an absent backup_root as invalid (null means 'not set', absence is an error); (3) before use, validate a string backup_root as an acceptable path: it must not overlap the root, any source, or a restore target, must not be a directory redirect, and must pass the path-safety rules in design.md; (4) for a configs/<sha256>.json snapshot, require the file name to equal the SHA-256 of its exact bytes and the manifest to list exactly one config entry.

backup_root.description: Backup root path, or null when not yet set.
